bio.en: Patent Engineer at Yang Hsu IP. MSc Psychological Studies from University of Glasgow, BA in Communication and Technology from National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University with a minor in Intellectual Property Law. Passed the 2022 Taiwan Bar Examination.
bio.zh: 陽煦智權專利工程師。英國格拉斯哥大學心理學碩士，國立陽明交通大學傳播與科技學系學士、法律學程/智慧財產法跨域。111年律師高考及格。
